conditions.end: the clip showed its last frame (and nothing else applies)
conditions.end_moving: the clip showed its last frame while move is held
conditions.reverse: move reversed above 50 % of top speed (BIBLE 3.1 turnaround skid)
conditions.jump: jump acts (press, buffer or coyote time)
conditions.airborne: no ground under the feet (ran or stepped off an edge, platform gone)
conditions.rising: vy > 1.5 u/s after a bonk (a low bough - the sim keeps some upward speed)
conditions.grounded_moving: touched ground with move held or horizontal speed
conditions.grounded_hard: touched ground after a long fall (the game's threshold)
conditions.ceiling: the head hit a ceiling while rising
conditions.ledge: the ledge assist fired (feet within 0.25 u below a lip at the apex)
conditions.kick: a kickable pebble meets the running foot

notes:
Space 95 - Jo's starter platformer set (space-95 PLAN-2026-10-18 section 5, BIBLE 3.1 and 9; Animator
PLAN A7). 16 clips on the human rig, game-timed: authored in real time @30 and played 2.4 x faster
(3 authored frames = one 24 fps sprite frame), so the physics QA judges is real and the game still feels
like its own numbers (studio/moves/platformer.py has the derivation).

- run: 8 u/s, 6 sprite frames a cycle (0.25 s), stride 2.0 u (step 1.0 u). The feet plant exactly at 8 u/s.
- jump_takeoff: on the ground for 2 sprite frames, the toes leave on sprite frame 2 (no input lag).
- rise / apex / fall / bonk / hurt are CARRIED: drawn in place, the game's physics moves them; QA judges
  the body on the declared game path (rise gravity 44.3 u/s^2, apex x 0.5, fall x 1.7, 18 u/s max fall).
- the woman and the man (D17) share every number here: timing, events and contact frames come from this
  brief, not from the mesh (tests/test_sprite.py builds the set at two heights and compares).

`requires` = the game's state changes measured on the L1 par route plus the ground and air ones the route
does not hit; the graph fails `make` if any of them has no transition (space-95 tests/anim.test.mjs reads
the same pairs). Run:

    powershell -File scripts\animator.ps1 make briefs\space95-jo-platformer.md --out <dir>

Outputs: jo.glb (rig), clips/jo_clips.glb (16 animations), clips/<clip>.json (sidecar), clips/<clip>.frames.json
(sprite frames + events), jo.graph.json, qa/<clip>.json, clips-sheet.png, clips.mp4, report.json.
